    nodes = case["nodes"]

    for a, b, d in dists:

    # Union-Find
    parent = {node: node for node in nodes}
    size = {node: 1 for node in nodes}
    def find(x):
        while parent[x] != x:
            parent[x] = parent[parent[x]]
            x = parent[x]
        return x
    def union(x, y):
        rx, ry = find(x), find(y)
        if rx == ry:

            rx, ry = ry, rx
        parent[ry] = rx
        size[rx] += size[ry]
        return True
